review_type: independent screenshot-led review after multi-viewport QA
strengths: The interface demonstrates real component state and proof history instead of presenting a static SaaS mockup.
Scenario replacement, resolve feedback, focus placement, and the local-only audit event form a coherent reversible task model.
Mobile promotes release health and the next decision before the secondary proof log.
remaining_limits: The dataset and audit times are fictional and no multi-user/backend states are represented.
The command dialog is intentionally small in scope and not a production command system.
Field Core Web Vitals and real user completion rates are pending.

adapt: bright lime is limited to state and action rather than used as ambient decoration
replace: generic bento dashboard replaced by one end-to-end decision state machine
remove: fake charts, glass cards, and feature-icon repetition
